verification_scope.integration: One original nominal 12-cell/60s drying_ramp+drying window only. No raw fields persisted, no fit/UQ/new mechanism/full-cycle/time-grid rerun.
verification_scope.surface: Field equals the already calculated outer-boundary surface temperature, not kiln or outer cell-center temperature.
verification_scope.boundary: All sampled states: R=outer current width/(2*total conductivity); q_cond=(Ts-Touter)/R; q_res=h*(Tf-Ts)+epsilon*sigma*(Tf^4-Ts^4); Qcond=A*q_cond compared with sum heat only, excluding carried mass enthalpy.
verification_scope.tolerance: Temperature residual divided by root Tr checked against existing atol+rtol*max(abs(Ts),abs(Touter),abs(Tf))/Tr. Heat-power residual converted through R/A to same temperature scale. Mapping differences/Tr below existing atol. No new fitted threshold.
verification_scope.samples: All nodes; selected initial/final/stage ends and maximum absolute kiln-surface gap node plus its neighbors and consecutive selected-time midpoints, independent linear interpolation.
verification_scope.old_mapping: Eight old kinds compared at selected times on same solution against parent mapping, also after new field removed.
verification_scope.parent_evidence: Compare inherited nominal window/stage ledgers, thermo/domain/dimension and drying criterion with preceding nominal observation evidence, not repeat parent integration.
verification_scope.limits: No surface measurement validation, arbitrary sampling convergence or qualification of historical swept-gas host.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

identities: Wilke Phi and species viscosity ratios are dimensionless; sum(y_i*mu_i/sum(y_j*Phi_ij))=Pa*s
-net_phase_rate*delta_mu/T=W/K; signed phase extent has units mol
outward_boundary_molar_flux*reservoir_mu/T=W/K; changing external y creates no internal inventory source
eta_dot=force/zeta=1/s; V0*force*eta_dot/T=W/K; positive zeta implies nonnegative mechanical dissipation
B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0=1; Bdot=B_n*ndot+B_x*xdot=1/s; fixed-x phase Cp=N*x*c=J/K; no double-counted equilibrium latent peak

limitations: Model outer-boundary temperature from the existing thermal resistance and convection/radiation closure; no thermometer model or real surface measurement. Drying-window validation only; historical swept-gas output code receives the same field but no new trajectory qualification. Whole-cycle and grid/time evidence retain earlier scope. Old product mapping equality is arithmetic only, not a drying-stage product claim.

independent_review.scope: Read-only output identity, boundary heat relation, existing mapping compatibility, actual numerical evidence and current scope claims. No additional integrations.
